title: R&D Student Developer
shortDescription: Designed an adjustable USB-C power supply using Arduino, C++, and C# as a summer student job
details:
R&D student job designing a compact, adjustable power supply in a portable form factor, powered by USB-C. Extracted the power supply functionality from an existing motherboard and redesigned it as a standalone unit.

Programmed an Arduino (C++) to control the hardware, applying SOLID principles through multiple abstraction layers — from hardware pin control up to a C# WPF GUI. The layered architecture made the system easy to extend. A first professional experience learning to translate real requirements into working solutions within a corporate environment.
